title: ResourceUID.remove_id() does not remove UIDs from cache and editor uses stale UIDs
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.5.1, 4.4.1
Not reproducible in: 4.3

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NV196 - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12600K (16 threads) - 62.56 GiB memory

### Issue description

Despite following the documentation and using
```
if ResourceUID.has_id(int_uid):
	ResourceUID.remove_id(int_uid)
``` 
to remove a UID, and
```
if not ResourceUID.has_id(int_uid):
	ResourceUID.add_id(int_uid, script_path)
```
to add a UID, Godot doesn't update the cached UIDs of `.gd` files.

It's necessary to delete `.godot/editor/filesystem_cache*` and restart the editor to get it to rebuild the cache and recognize the new UIDs. Sometimes even _that_ doesn't work.

### Steps to reproduce

With the MRP, opening the project should immediately show a warning about duplicate UIDs. Opening `main.tscn` and clicking the root control node, two export tool buttons will become available in the inspector. "Replace UID" will replace the UID of one file using the methods in `ResourceUID`.  "Clear Cache" will delete `.godot/uid_cache.bin`. Restarting the editor will still show the same warning.

----

With a new project, create two script files with the same content in their `.gd.uid` files. Restart the editor and get the warning about duplicate IDs. Then try replacing a UIDs with 
```
var old_int_uid = ResourceUID.text_to_id(duplicate_uid)
if ResourceUID.has_id(old_int_uid):
	ResourceUID.remove_id(old_int_uid)
var new_int_uid := ResourceUID.create_id()
if not ResourceUID.has_id(new_int_uid):
	ResourceUID.add_id(new_int_uid, path)
var new_uid = ResourceUID.id_to_text(new_int_uid)
```
And replace the contents of the `.gd.uid` file (matching `path` var above) with the `new_uid`. Then restart the editor. Duplicate UID warning will still be there.


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[2026-01-15-uid-cache-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24655987/2026-01-15-uid-cache-bug.zip)
